say:2:1641108001:1.text: Woah! Magister! You finally revealed your true identity!
say:2:1641108001:1.source_cn: 哇！主人，你终于公开身份啦！
say:2:1641108001:1.male: Woah! Magister! You finally revealed your true identity!
say:2:1641108001:1.female: Woah! Magister! You finally revealed your true identity!

say:3:1641108002:1.text: You pulled off the whole investigation without blowing your cover! That's amazing!
say:3:1641108002:1.source_cn: 主人你真的好厉害呀！隐藏身份那么久还顺利完成了调查！
say:3:1641108002:1.male: You pulled off the whole investigation without blowing your cover! That's amazing!
say:3:1641108002:1.female: You pulled off the whole investigation without blowing your cover! That's amazing!

say:4:1641108003:1.text: *Sniffle* Does this mean Chippy can go back to following you around every day again?
say:4:1641108003:1.source_cn: 呜呜呜……满满又可以每天都跟着主人啦对不对！
say:4:1641108003:1.male: *Sniffle* Does this mean Chippy can go back to following you around every day again?
say:4:1641108003:1.female: *Sniffle* Does this mean Chippy can go back to following you around every day again?

say:5:1641108004:1.text: Hey! I've got something to report!

choice_prompt:6:1641108004.text: Hey! I've got something to report!

say:7:1641108005:1.text: Just between us... now that you've outed yourself as Merlin, the school's probably going to start paying you again, right?
say:7:1641108005:1.source_cn: 满满偷偷说，你公开了梅林的身份，学院肯定又得发薪水啦。
say:7:1641108005:1.male: Just between us... now that you've outed yourself as Merlin, the school's probably going to start paying you again, right?
say:7:1641108005:1.female: Just between us... now that you've outed yourself as Merlin, the school's probably going to start paying you again, right?

say:8:1641108006:1.text: Chippy's totally buttering you up so you'll take him snack-hunting again.
say:8:1641108006:1.source_cn: 我看呀，他就是惦记着让你带他去商业街吃好吃的呢！
say:8:1641108006:1.male: Chippy's totally buttering you up so you'll take him snack-hunting again.
say:8:1641108006:1.female: Chippy's totally buttering you up so you'll take him snack-hunting again.

say:9:1641108007:1.text: H-Hammie! You weren't supposed to say that! Ugh, fine, it's true...
say:9:1641108007:1.source_cn: 漫、漫漫！你怎么全说出来了……唔，好吧，没错……

say:10:1641108008:1.text: Since you were gone, the snack vault has been empty, and Chippy's belly has flatter than a squished pancake...
say:10:1641108008:1.source_cn: 主人不在的时候，零食库都是空的……满满的肚子都饿扁了……
say:10:1641108008:1.male: Since you were gone, the snack vault has been empty, and Chippy's belly has flatter than a squished pancake...
say:10:1641108008:1.female: Since you were gone, the snack vault has been empty, and Chippy's belly has flatter than a squished pancake...

say:11:1641108009:1.text: Zorya says there's glowing mega-fruit for sale in the market! Chippy has been drooling over it for days!
say:11:1641108009:1.source_cn: 佐尔娅女士说商业街上有会发光的大果子卖，满满都馋好久了！

say:12:1641108010:1.text: And there's the tavern street... Chippy wonders if their drinks taste anything like dwarven brew...
say:12:1641108010:1.source_cn: 还有酒吧街，不知道那儿的酒和矮人们的烈酒比起来味道怎么样……

choice_prompt:13:1641108010.text: And there's the tavern street... Chippy wonders if their drinks taste anything like dwarven brew...
choice_prompt:13:1641108010.source_cn: 还有酒吧街，不知道那儿的酒和矮人们的烈酒比起来味道怎么样……

say:14:1641108011:1.text: Just kidding! Chippy will stick to acorn fizz!
say:14:1641108011:1.source_cn: 开玩笑的，满满喝橡果饮料就好啦！

say:15:1641108013:1.text: But hey, what matters is we're back, and we can adventure together again!
say:15:1641108013:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，现在我们回来啦！

say:16:1641108014:1.text: Sir Chippy back in action! Onward, to the Serene Lyceum and beyond!
say:16:1641108014:1.source_cn: 伟大的满满骑士！出动！莱希拉姆大探索，冲冲冲！

choice:13:0:1.text: You're absolutely not allowed to drink.
choice:13:0:1.male: You're absolutely not allowed to drink.
choice:13:0:1.female: You're absolutely not allowed to drink.

say:18:1641108012:1.text: Hammie! You snitch! But Chippy knew it. Magister wouldn't let Chippy go hungry!
say:18:1641108012:1.source_cn: 漫漫你还告状！我就知道主人会带我去吃好吃的！
say:18:1641108012:1.male: Hammie! You snitch! But Chippy knew it. Magister wouldn't let Chippy go hungry!
say:18:1641108012:1.female: Hammie! You snitch! But Chippy knew it. Magister wouldn't let Chippy go hungry!

choice:13:1:2.text: I'm loaded with gold now. I'll get you whatever you crave!
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 我现在钱多着呢，尽管挑
choice:13:1:2.male: I'm loaded with gold now. I'll get you whatever you crave!
choice:13:1:2.female: I'm loaded with gold now. I'll get you whatever you crave!

choice:6:0:1.text: Alright, let's hear it. You'll be rewarded if it checks out.
choice:6:0:1.male: Alright, let's hear it. You'll be rewarded if it checks out.
choice:6:0:1.female: Alright, let's hear it. You'll be rewarded if it checks out.
